visual_copy_on_image: The real cost of the night argument is not the lost sleep. It is the resentment that stays awake long after the baby sleeps.
Resentment builds when one parent always carries the night. The other partner is not lazy — they just never got a system.

post_copy.hook_text: A request creates a favour. A schedule creates a default. Giving your partner a named shift is a status upgrade, not charity.
post_copy.problem_text: Asking directly for help can feel like an accusation. The partner's one-off gesture resets the expectation: he helped once, so the default remains she owns all of it.
post_copy.bold_line: Reframes the partner from 'helper' to 'co-manager' — a status upgrade instead of a request for charity. A written roster removes the emotional labour of asking: the schedule asks, not her.
